jobs.title: FP&A Analyst
jobs.description:
Become part of a team that champions wellness worldwide. CAPTEK® Softgel International is a global leader in the development and production of high\-quality nutraceutical supplements. As a contract manufacturer organization (CMO), we collaborate with innovators from some of the world’s most successful brands.
  
  

**Summary:** The FP\&A Analyst supports budgeting, forecasting, management reporting, pricing analysis, and financial decision\-making across CAPTEK. Reporting to the FP\&A Manager, this role prepares recurring analyses, maintains financial models, identifies business trends, and partners with Sales, Operations, Accounting, and other cross functional teams. The analyst also supports finished\-goods pricing, quotation activities, and provides actionable insights that help improve profitability, drive efficiency, and cost management.
  
Essential Duties and Responsibilities
  
* Support the annual budgeting and periodic forecasting processes by gathering inputs, maintaining budget models, documenting assumptions, preparing schedules, and analyzing results in collaboration with the FP\&A Manager, Cost Accounting Manager, and Director of Accounting
* Maintain and enhance customer pricing models, validate cost and margin inputs, and prepare analyses that support accurate, consistent, and profitable pricing decisions
* Provide analytical support for pricing decisions for both existing and new customers by evaluating price, volume, cost, margin, and other relevant business factors
* Build and maintain pricing calculators and financial models for new business opportunities, document key assumptions and data sources, and perform quality checks to ensure outputs are accurate and reproducible
* Perform sensitivity and scenario analyses to evaluate how changes in pricing, volume, product mix, labor, materials, production assumptions, and market conditions may affect revenue, cost, margin, and profitability
* Partner with Sales, Operations, and Cost Accounting to analyze customer and SKU profitability, including product cost, gross margin, contribution margin, pricing, volume, and mix, and highlight opportunities or risks for management review
* Analyze financial and operational performance against company goals, budgets/forecasts, and key performance indicators; identify favorable and unfavorable trends; and communicate significant variances and business drivers
* Support monthly financial reviews by preparing sales and margin bridges, budget\-to\-actual and forecast\-to\-actual variance analyses, and summaries of the key drivers affecting revenue, gross margin, operating expenses, and profitability. Investigate significant variances and provide concise commentary on key trends and risks
* Prepare, validate, and distribute recurring weekly, monthly, and quarterly reporting, including flash reports, sales reports, departmental expense reports, customer and SKU profitability analyses, and plant spend reports
* Prepare ROI and financial feasibility analyses for proposed investments and summarize key assumptions, risks, and expected returns to support management decision\-making
* Perform ad\-hoc reporting, analysis and other tasks as needed to support Finance, Sales, Operations and the executive leadership team


Qualifications
  
* Excellent organizational and communication (oral and written) skills
* Advanced knowledge of Microsoft Excel
* Financial Modeling experience a plus
* Understanding of ERP system, Syspro a plus
* General business acumen
* Excellent attention to detail
* Effectively prioritize and multi\-task to complete work and meet deadlines
* Have strong problem\-solving skills
* Process improvement and streamlining work cross\-functionally


**Education \& Experience:**  

* Bachelor's Degree in accounting/finance (preferred)
* 3\+ years preferred in same or related position

jobs.title: Sr Financial Analyst
jobs.description:
**About Crane:**

  

Crane Aerospace \& Electronics supplies critical systems and components to the aerospace and defense markets. You’ll find Crane Aerospace \& Electronics in some of the toughest environments: from engines to landing gear; from satellites to medical implants and from missiles to unmanned aerial systems (UAS). Every 1\.2 seconds, product built at our Crane Aerospace \& Electronics Burbank facility is stopping aircraft – delivering passengers and military personnel safely to their destination. Home to our Landing \& Cabin Systems team, Crane A\&E’s brake control systems and premium cabin actuation solutions are flying on tens of thousands of aircraft throughout the world. You’ll join a business with a long track record of engineering excellence, set in the wonderful town of Burbank filled with great community atmosphere, schools, weather and no shortage of entertainment.  



  

**Job Summary**

  

The Senior Financial Analyst develops, analyzes, and maintains complex financial data to support both short\- and long‑term business objectives. Reporting to the Senior Controller, this role performs advanced financial reporting, forecasting, and modeling, applying expert‑level knowledge of financial theory and practices. Assignments range from highly specialized analyses to broad evaluations across multiple financial areas and require strong judgment, rigorous evaluation of data, and the ability to interpret complex or intangible business conditions.


The ideal candidate is motivated, proactive, resourceful, and detail‑oriented, with excellent organizational, communication, and critical‑thinking skills. This role requires adaptability and the ability to partner effectively across the organization **.**

  

  

**Essential Functions**

  

* Support strategy, annual budgeting, and rolling forecasting processes for the local entity and across business units.
* Prepare and analyze P\&L, Balance Sheet, and Cash Flow variance reports related to budget, forecast, and prior‑year results.
* Lead KPI forecasting for assigned business groups, including headcount, capital, and operating expenses.
* Serve as a finance lead on assigned internal projects; collaborate with cross‑functional teams to understand key business issues and translate them into financial models, metrics, and insights. Support the Oracle ERP migration project.
* Provide actionable insights on revenue, spending variances, and department‑level performance to business partners.
* Provide back‑up support to the Senior Controller by learning and preparing required financial reports and analyses.
* Develop financial models and scenario analyses to support strategic and operational decision‑making; assist management with analysis of customer programs, projects, investments, and other initiatives.
* Partner with business leaders to understand key financial and operational drivers, identify trends, and translate business performance into meaningful insights.
* Monitor revenue, expenses, working capital, capital expenditures, and cash flow performance relative to budget and forecast.
* Build, improve, and maintain financial reporting tools, dashboards, and KPIs to enhance business performance visibility.
* Support month‑end close activities, including reviewing and approving journal entries.
* Lead process improvement initiatives to drive efficiency and enhance financial reporting practices.
* Perform other tasks as assigned by the supervisor or management **.**

  

**Minimum Qualifications**

  

* 8\+ years of experience in a Financial Analyst role or equivalent analytical position.
* Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related discipline.
* 5\+ years of progressive FP\&A or corporate finance experience.
* Proven experience developing annual budgets and financial forecasts.
* Strong financial modeling and analytical capabilities.
* Advanced proficiency with MS Excel and financial analysis tools.
* Deep understanding of financial statements, cash flow, and key financial/operational metrics.
* Exceptional attention to detail and ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines.
* Excellent analytical, problem‑solving, and organizational skills.
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
Ability to work independently and collaborate effectively across functions in a fast‑paced environment.  
* 

  

**Eligibility Requirement:** This position may require access to Controlled Data or Information. Where the position requires such access only US Persons will be considered. As a US Department of Defense contractor, we are bound by International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR).  



  

**Preferred Qualifications**

  

* MBA, CPA, CMA, or other relevant professional certification.
* Experience in aerospace, defense, aviation, or manufacturing industries.
* Experience with ERP systems and financial planning/reporting tools.
* Experience with project‑based or program‑based financial analysis.
* Experience developing dashboards and management‑level reporting.
Public company experience.  
* 

  

**Top Benefits:**

You can see a list of our benefits at https://www.craneae.com/company/careers or visit our website at www.CraneAE.com for more information on our company and great opportunities.


We are committed to operational excellence and world class processes. We employ Lean manufacturing techniques to optimize manufacturing efficiency and accuracy on all product lines. Our products are known for their technical strength, proven reliability and overall value.

jobs.title: Associate Buyer, Footwear
jobs.description:
**WHY JOIN ALO?**



Mindful movement. It's at the core of why we do what we do at ALO—it's our calling. Because mindful movement in the studio leads to better living. It changes who yogis are off the mat, making their lives and their communities better. That's the real meaning of studio\-to\-street: taking the consciousness from practice on the mat and putting it into practice in life.

**OVERVIEW**



As the Associate Buyer, you will own multiple categories within the broader division, managing seasonal buys, receipt management, weekly business analysis, and reacting to in\-season business insights and opportunities. As a design\-led company, you will bring a strong analytical perspective to the business, leveraging data and business insights to support the successful execution of the product vision.



The Associate Buyer will partner cross\-functionally with Buying, Merchandising, and Planning \& Allocation to align on pre\-season and in\-season strategy and implementation while providing data\-driven recommendations to support business decisions.



At ALO, our in\-office collaboration and culture is one of our greatest assets, we believe in being together to build strong team partnership and cross functional team relationships, this position requires to be full time in office.


**RESPONSIBILITIES**


* Monitor category performance closely and translate business trends into action by making informed decisions and adjusting receipts as needed to chase upside, mitigate risk, optimize inventory, and maximize sales.
* Manage the preparation and distribution of weekly and quarterly business reports, ensuring data is accurate and complete. Proactively share reporting with cross\-functional partners and leadership, providing clear and timely communication to support business decisions.
* Partner closely with Buying, Merchandising, and Planning \& Allocation to execute seasonal and in\-season strategies, ensuring alignment on sales, inventory, receipt, and assortment priorities.
* Develop bottom\-up, SKU\-level buys for seasonal items, ensuring forecasts are grounded in historical results, current business performance, and aligned with agreed\-upon sales targets.
* Conduct PO management tasks such as tracking and monitoring warehouse ETAs and in\-turn advise the merchandising team whether launch dates will be met or at risk.
* Compose quarterly hindsight presentation by leveraging business analysis, customer insights, and business trends. Provide clear, actionable recommendations to guide merchandising partners in making assortment and product decisions.
* Proactively anticipate the needs of managers and leaders by preparing ahead for milestone meetings, identifying key questions and business insights, and ensuring relevant data, analysis, and materials are readily available to support decision\-making.


**QUALIFICATIONS**


* 2\+ years of experience in merchandising, buying, or planning
* Strong business acumen and analytical skills
* Entrepreneurial spirit and ownership mindset
* Strong time management and ability to prioritize in a fast\-paced environment
* Natural leader and problem solver with a growth mindset
* Highly detail\-oriented with strong attention to accuracy
* Excellent communication, organizational, and interpersonal skills
* Advanced Excel skills

jobs.title: Purchaser/Buyer Agent
jobs.description:
**Purchaser/Buyer Agent**

**Join Our Team:**


We are seeking a detail\-oriented and proactive **Purchaser/Buyer Agent** to join our growing team. This role is responsible for managing the purchasing process from order placement through fulfillment, building strong vendor relationships, negotiating competitive pricing, and ensuring timely delivery of products. The ideal candidate thrives in a fast\-paced environment, enjoys problem\-solving, and excels at coordinating with suppliers, customers, and internal teams.


If you are highly organized, customer\-focused, and enjoy working in purchasing with vendors and sales teams to keep operations running smoothly, we'd love to hear from you.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Create, process, and manage purchase orders with suppliers, vendors, and manufacturers.
* Coordinate product procurement and fulfillment to ensure accurate and timely delivery.
* Negotiate pricing, terms, and delivery schedules with suppliers to maximize value and cost savings.
* Maintain strong relationships with vendors and manufacturers while monitoring supplier performance.
* Track and follow up on order status, shipments, backorders, and delivery schedules.
* Process and distribute purchase orders, invoices, and related purchasing documentation.
* Review and analyze purchasing reports and ad hoc data to support business decisions.
* Ensure customer requirements are accurately communicated and executed, including:
	+ Product specifications and configurations
	+ Quantity increases or decreases
	+ Split shipments and multiple orders
	+ Special customer requirements
	+ Multiple shipping locations
* Serve as a liaison between suppliers, customers, sales teams, and internal departments regarding order status, updates, delays, and fulfillment issues.
* Resolve purchasing and fulfillment discrepancies while maintaining a high level of customer service.
* Maintain accurate records and data within company systems and purchasing platforms.

**Qualifications Required:**

* Proficiency in Microsoft Office, including Excel and Word.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Strong customer service and relationship\-building abilities.
* Exceptional attention to detail and organizational skills.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast\-paced environment.
* Strong problem\-solving and follow\-up skills.
* Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with cross\-functional teams.

**Preferred:**

* Experience in purchasing, procurement, order management, supply chain, inside sales support, or related roles.
* Knowledge of IT, technology, or Audio Visual (AV) products and solutions.
* Experience working with ERP systems such as NetSuite, Quosal, or similar platforms.
* Experience negotiating pricing and managing vendor relationships.

**What You'll Bring:**

* A sense of urgency and ownership.
* Strong analytical and critical\-thinking skills.
* A customer\-first mindset.
* The ability to build productive relationships with suppliers and internal stakeholders.
* A commitment to accuracy, efficiency, and continuous improvement.

**Compensation \& Benefits:**

* Competitive salary
* Medical, dental, and vision coverage
* 401(k) plan
* Paid vacation
* Additional company perks

**Golden Star Technology Inc. (GST)**, headquartered in Cerritos, California, has been recognized by the *Los Angeles Business Journal* as one of **LA's Best Places to Work** for six consecutive years. As a leading provider of IT and audiovisual (AV) solutions and services, GST serves small and mid\-sized businesses, enterprises, government agencies, and educational institutions nationwide.


Since its founding in 1985, GST has built a strong reputation for innovation, reliability, and customer commitment. The company's continued growth is driven by its ability to deliver a comprehensive portfolio of industry\-leading technology solutions, customized configurations, and exceptional customer service. jobs.title: Paid Social Media Buyer & Optimization Specialist
jobs.description:
**About us:**


Your Behavioral Health (https://yourbehavioralhealth.com/) (YBH) is a private equity backed behavioral healthcare services company representing a well\-renowned family of brands across Southern California, including Clear Behavioral Health, Neuro Wellness Spa, and New Life House. Through our family of brands, we provide the full continuum of care to their clients. Our approach is individualized, holistic, and evidence\-based to give our clients the best possible chance at long\-term recovery. We pride ourselves on providing an expert clinical team who are highly skilled in the latest in evidence\-based treatments and therapies.


**Position Summary:**


The Paid Social Media Buyer \& Optimization Specialist is responsible for planning, launching, managing, optimizing, and reporting on paid social advertising campaigns across Meta (Facebook and Instagram) and other social platforms. This role drives qualified inquiries, patient acquisitions, and brand awareness through audience targeting, budget management, performance optimization, testing, and analytics.


### **The key areas of responsibility include:**


**Campaign Strategy \& Execution**


* Build, launch, and manage paid social campaigns across Meta platforms.
* Develop campaign structures for multiple brands/accounts aligned to service lines, target audiences, and geographic markets.
* Create and maintain audience segments using demographic, behavioral, geographic, and interest\-based targeting.
* Coordinate with creative and landing page resources to ensure campaign assets support performance goals.
* Manage campaign setup including objectives, tracking, budgets, placements, and conversion events.


**Budget Management**


* Allocate and manage advertising budgets efficiently across campaigns, regions, locations, and service lines.
* Monitor pacing and spend to ensure budget adherence and maximize return on investment.
* Reallocate spend based on performance trends and business priorities.


**Optimization \& Testing**


* Perform ongoing optimization of campaigns to improve lead quality and conversion rates.
* Conduct A/B testing of audiences, creative assets, copy, placements, and landing pages.
* Monitor key performance indicators including:
	+ Reach
	+ Impressions
	+ CTR
	+ CPC
	+ CPL
	+ Conversion Rate
	+ Cost Per Acquisition (CPA/CAC)
	+ ROAS (where applicable)
* Identify opportunities to improve performance through audience refinement and creative recommendations.


**Analytics \& Reporting**


* Develop recurring reporting dashboards and scorecards.
* Analyze performance trends and provide actionable recommendations.
* Generate weekly, monthly, and quarterly reports for marketing leadership.
* Translate campaign data into business insights and strategic recommendations.
* Partner with admissions, CRM, and analytics teams to improve attribution and measurement.


**Collaboration**


* Work with scheduler and content teams to ensure that creative is aligned with campaign objective and optimized for success.
* Support integrated campaigns across paid, organic, SEO, email, and community engagement channels.
* Ensure campaign execution aligns with brand standards and compliance requirements


**Qualifications**


**Required**


* 3\-5\+ years of hands\-on paid social advertising experience.
* Experience managing Meta Ads Manager campaigns.
* Strong understanding of audience segmentation and digital marketing funnels.
* Experience with conversion tracking, pixels, event tracking, and UTM parameters.
* Advanced Excel and reporting skills.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving abilities.


**Preferred**


* Healthcare, behavioral health, or consumer services marketing experience.
* Experience with Google Analytics (GA4\).
* Experience with Salesforce, Marketing Cloud, HubSpot, or similar CRM platforms.
* Exposure to TikTok, Reddit, LinkedIn, or YouTube advertising.
* Experience with dashboard/reporting tools such as Power BI, Looker Studio, or Tableau.


**Benefits:**

  

* Medical, dental, and vision insurance
* Life and disability coverage
* Retirement plan
* Paid sick, time off, and holidays
* Employee Assistance Program
* Professional development opportunities
* Other company \- sponsored wellness or support programs


**Pay:** $85,000\-$95,000 per year.


**Schedule:** Monday through Friday on\-site.

jobs.title: Financial Analyst II
jobs.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century's most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril's family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI\-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting\-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

### **ABOUT THE TEAM**



Anduril's Maritime Dominance division builds advanced autonomous undersea vehicle systems designed to deter, compel, and defeat adversaries at scale. Our portfolio — including platforms like Dive\-LD and Copperhead — spans high\-performance multi\-mission undersea vehicles purpose\-built for contested environments and hyper\-scale production. The Maritime Finance team provides the financial infrastructure to support programs as they scale from rapid development through production ramp, partnering with engineering, manufacturing, supply chain, and program leadership to maintain cost visibility and financial rigor across a fast\-growing portfolio.

  

### **ABOUT THE JOB**



As a Financial Analyst, you will provide dedicated finance support to the Undersea Reconnaissance \& Strike Business Line within the Maritime Division. This portfolio spans cutting\-edge AUV programs that are rapidly scaling from development into production. Your primary focus will be tracking and forecasting the cost build\-up of hardware programs — understanding how material, labor, and overhead flow through each stage of the product lifecycle and translating that into reliable baselines, forecasts, and variance analysis.  

  

You will work closely with Program Managers, Manufacturing, Supply Chain, and Accounting to ensure cost visibility keeps pace with program execution. This role requires someone who can operate autonomously, drive projects from inception to completion, and communicate financial performance clearly to cross\-functional stakeholders.

  

#### **WHAT YOU'LL DO**


* Own program\-level cost forecasting and EAC/ETC development for hardware programs transitioning from development to production
* Build and maintain bottoms\-up cost models that capture material, labor, overhead, and subcontract elements across the hardware build cycle
* Track actuals against baselines, identify variances, and drive root\-cause analysis with program teams
* Support the development and improvement of forecasting workflows in FP\&A and ERP tools (Oracle, Hyperion EPM, Foundry)
* Contribute to long\-range planning and production rate ramp financial modeling  

Drive continuous improvement in reporting accuracy, data integrity, and process efficiency

#### **REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS**


* 1\-3 years of experience in FP\&A, program finance, or cost analysis — preferably in an environment that manufactures or integrates hardware
* Bachelor's degree or higher in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or related field  

Ability to operate independently in a fast\-paced, high\-growth environment and carry projects forward with minimal direction
* Excellent communication skills — comfortable presenting financial narratives and variance explanations to non\-finance stakeholders
* Must be authorized to work in the United States

#### **PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**


* DoD industry experience or familiarity with government contract cost accounting (FAR/CAS)
* Security clearance (or ability to obtain one)
* Exposure to supply chain or manufacturing finance
* Experience building or managing cost models for physical products (BOM\-based costing, production cost build\-ups, or similar)
* Strong understanding of how material, labor, and indirect costs flow through a manufacturing or defense program lifecycle
* Proficiency with financial systems and data tools; experience with ERP platforms (Oracle preferred) is a plus


The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. jobs.title: Finance Development Program Analyst
jobs.description:
* Sunnyvale, CA, United States
* Not Remote
* Students \& University
* JOB218834


  
### **Company Description**


It started with a simple idea: what if surgery could be less invasive and recovery less painful? Nearly 30 years later, that question still fuels everything we do at **Intuitive**. As a global leader in **robotic\-assisted surgery** and **minimally invasive care**, our technologies—like the **da Vinci surgical system** and **Ion**—have transformed how care is delivered for millions of patients worldwide.


We’re a team of engineers, clinicians, and innovators united by one purpose: to make surgery smarter, safer, and more human. Every day, our work helps care teams perform with greater precision and patients recover faster, improving outcomes around the world.


The problems we solve demand creativity, rigor, and collaboration. The work is challenging, but deeply meaningful—because every improvement we make has the potential to change a life.


If you’re ready to contribute to something bigger than yourself and help **transform the future of healthcare**, you’ll find your purpose here.


### **Job Description**


**Primary Function of Position**


The Finance Development Program (FDP) Analyst is an entry\-level professional role designed to develop core finance and analytics capabilities through a structured two\-year rotational program consisting of three 8\-month assignments across multiple finance functions.


In each rotation, the FDP Analyst performs financial planning, reporting, and analytical work that supports business decision\-making. The role works with finance and cross\-functional stakeholders to analyze data, develop insights, and contribute to key financial processes, including close, forecast, and budget cycles.


The FDP Analyst builds financial models, develops reporting tools, and communicates analysis results to support business understanding. Work is performed under guidance, with increasing ownership of deliverables and complexity of analysis over time. The role may also include exposure to core accounting processes to support development of a foundational understanding of financial reporting and compliance requirements.


**Essential Job Duties**


Core Financial Planning, Reporting, and Analysis:


* Perform financial and operational analysis to support monthly close, quarterly forecasting, and annual planning processes
* Analyze and support reporting of business performance, including variance analysis against forecast and budget
* Prepare financial reporting packages, dashboards, and summaries for management review
* Support cost center management including expense tracking, forecasting, and budgeting

Analytics, Modeling, and Insight Generation:


* Develop and maintain financial models with guidance (e.g., ROI, scenario analysis)
* Analyze data to identify trends, drivers, risks, and opportunities; summarize findings into structured insights
* Create and maintain dashboards, reporting tools, and KPIs
* Perform ad hoc analysis to support business questions

Execution and Ownership of Deliverables:


* Execute recurring financial processes (reporting, forecasting, dashboards) with accuracy and timeliness
* Take responsibility for defined deliverables or components of workstreams
* Maintain quality and integrity of financial outputs

Business Partnership and Communication:


* Collaborate with finance teams and cross\-functional partners
* Communicate analysis results and insights clearly to stakeholders
* Participate in business discussions and provide analytical input to support decisions

Process Improvement:


* Identify and contribute to process improvement opportunities
* Support automation and standardization efforts

Basic Accounting Exposure (Selected Rotations Only):


* Support selected accounting activities such as financial close processes, preparation of journal entries, and account reconciliations with guidance
* Assist in documenting financial transactions and maintaining supporting documentation
* Gain exposure to financial reporting requirements, including U.S. GAAP principles and internal controls

Progression Across Rotations:


* + Early: Execute analyses with guidance and develop foundational skills
	+ Mid: Perform analyses with decreasing guidance and assume ownership of recurring deliverables
	+ Late: Manage assigned deliverables with limited supervision and contribute insights in discussions

### **Qualifications**


**Required Skills and Experience**


* 0–2 years of relevant experience in finance, accounting, or analytics
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills
* Basic experience with financial analysis, including exposure to budgeting, forecasting, and financial modeling
* Basic understanding of accounting principles (e.g., financial statements, debits/credits)
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and familiarity with data analytical tools (e.g., SQL, Tableau)
* Ability to translate analysis into clear, structured insights
* Strong attention to detail and commitment to data accuracy

jobs.title: Financial Analyst
jobs.description:
Astranis builds advanced satellites for high orbits, expanding humanity's reach into the solar system. Today Astranis satellites provide dedicated, secure networks to highly\-sophisticated customers across the globe – large enterprises, sovereign governments, and the US military.



With five satellites on orbit and many more set to launch soon, the company is servicing a backlog of more than $1 billion of commercial contracts. Astranis is the preferred satellite communications partner for buyers with stringent requirements for uptime, data security, network visibility, and customization.



Astranis has raised over $1\.2 billion from some of the world's best investors, including Andreessen Horowitz, Baillie Gifford, Blackrock, Fidelity, Franklin Templeton, and Snowpoint, and employs a team of 500 engineers and entrepreneurs. Astranis designs, builds, and operates its satellites out of its 153,000 sq. ft. headquarters in Northern California, USA.

#### **Financial Analyst**



As Astranis's Financial Analyst, you will partner cross\-functionally across engineering, program management, and business teams to ensure financial discipline and clarity as we scale. We are seeking an analysis\-driven finance professional who thrives at budgeting, forecasting, and tracking program spend while driving accountability across company initiatives.



You are an ideal candidate if you have strong analytical skills, can manage detailed financial models, and are eager to balance an analysis\-heavy workload with strategic business partnership. You should be motivated by tracking program budgets, evaluating cost trade\-offs, and improving transparency into how Astranis invests its resources.


#### **Role**


* Own program budgeting, spend tracking, financial planning, reporting, and analysis, serving as a key financial partner to program managers and cross\-functional teams.
* Support program managers and project leads in tracking budgets, actuals, and forecasts against key milestones.
* Balance rigorous financial analysis with effective cross\-functional business partnership and clear communication.
* Partner with department and initiative leaders on headcount planning, resource allocation, and spend management.
* Deliver timely variance analysis and actionable insights to drive departmental and program accountability.
* Build scalable reporting tools and dashboards to provide leadership with clear visibility into program and operating costs.
* Support the monthly and quarterly close process in coordination with Accounting and Finance.

#### **Requirements**


* 1–3 years of financial planning \& analysis (FP\&A) or corporate finance experience.
* Bachelor's degree in finance, accounting, economics, or a related field.
* Strong financial modeling, Excel, and reporting skills, with experience managing budgets and project/program spend tracking.
* Detail\-oriented mindset with the ability to "zoom out" and provide strategic insights to business leaders.
* Demonstrated ability to work cross\-functionally, bridging the gap between data analysis and operational decision\-making.
* High adaptability and curiosity to operate in a fast\-paced technology or hardware company environment.

**U.S. Citizenship, Lawful Permanent Residency, or Refugee/Asylee Status Required**
(To comply with U.S. Government space technology export regulations, applicant must be a U.S. citizen, lawful permanent resident of the United States, or other protected individual as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3\))

Our mission and products are built for everyone, regardless of gender, race, creed, or background. We believe in a diverse and inclusive workplace, and we invite all people to join our team and bring their unique perspectives to make us stronger.

The Buyer position will be responsible for the purchasing and procurement of perishable agricultural commodities within an assigned group of categories or commodities. jobs.title: Senior Financial Analyst
jobs.description:
What We Need
  
Corpay is currently looking to hire a Senior Financial Analyst within our Finance division. This position falls under our US Vehicle Payments line of business and is Remote. In this role, you will support expense management, budgeting, forecasting, and performance analysis for several business functions. You will support a portfolio of cost centers across Sales, Marketing, Credit, Processing, Servicing, and General \& Administrative functions. The analyst will work closely with business leaders, Accounting, Human Resources, and other cross\-functional teams to improve financial visibility and support budget decisions.You will report directly to the Senior Director of Financial Planning \& Analysis and regularly collaborate with multiple teams.
  
How We Work
  
As a Senior Financial Analyst, Corpay will set you up for success by providing:
  
* Company\-issued equipment
* Formal, hands\-on training


Role Responsibilities
  
  

**The responsibilities of the role will include:**  

Expense Management and Business Partnership
  
* Serve as the FP\&A partner for assigned USVP functions and cost centers, providing financial support to business leaders and budget owners.
* Develop an understanding of each supported function's cost structure and key financial drivers.
* Monitor operating expenses against budget and forecast and flag notable variances or trends.
* Meet regularly with business leaders to review financial performance and discuss forecast updates.
* Help evaluate spending requests for affordability and alignment with the approved budget.
* Provide financial insights that support day\-to\-day decision\-making.


Budgeting and Forecasting
  
* Support the preparation of annual budgets and periodic forecasts for assigned business functions.
* Build and maintain expense models using headcount assumptions, historical trends, and business input.
* Coordinate planning timelines with business partners to help ensure assumptions are accurate and submitted on time.
* Maintain documentation of forecast assumptions and changes from prior estimates.
* Consolidate financial inputs from multiple sources and flag inconsistencies for review.


Month\-End Close and Financial Reporting
  
* Support the monthly close process by reviewing general ledger activity and flagging unusual transactions.
* Partner with Accounting on accruals, reclasses, and coding updates.
* Help prepare expense accrual estimates using invoices, contracts, and historical spending patterns.
* Prepare monthly variance analysis comparing actual results to budget and forecast.
* Write clear commentary explaining the drivers behind significant variances.
* Assist with monthly financial packages and management presentations.


Workforce and Headcount Support
  
* Support workforce planning for assigned functions, including headcount, new hires, and attrition.
* Help reconcile headcount plans with data from Human Resources and departmental leaders.
* Track the financial impact of hiring timing, vacancies, and organizational changes.


Financial Analysis and Decision Support
  
* Perform ad hoc financial analysis on vendor spending, cost trends, and process improvements.
* Support the development of business cases for new initiatives and staffing requests.
* Analyze spending trends to help identify root causes and recommend next steps.
* Help track savings initiatives and check whether projected benefits show up in actual results.


Reporting, Data, and Process Improvement
  
* Build and maintain financial models, reports, and templates that support FP\&A processes.
* Use Microsoft Dynamics 365, Planful, Power BI, Excel, and other systems to pull and analyze data.
* Partner with cross\-functional teams to help resolve data and reporting issues.
* Suggest ways to simplify recurring reporting processes.


Qualifications \& Skills
  
Required Qualifications
  
* Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business Administration, or a related field.
* Three to five years of experience in FP\&A, corporate finance, expense management, or a related discipline.
* Experience supporting budgets and forecasts for at least one department or business function.
* Working knowledge of operating expenses, financial statements, and the month\-end close process.
* Strong Microsoft Excel skills, including formulas, pivot tables, and reporting.
* Ability to work with large data sets and translate findings into clear, actionable insights.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines in a fast\-paced environment.


Preferred Qualifications
  
* Experience with Microsoft Dynamics 365, Planful, Power BI, or similar systems.
* Experience with workforce planning or vendor\-spend analysis.
* Experience supporting operational teams such as customer service, sales, or marketing.
* Experience helping prepare materials for senior leaders.


Benefits \& Perks
  
* Medical, Dental \& Vision benefits available the 1st month after hire
* Automatic enrollment into our 401(k) plan (subject to eligibility requirements)
* Virtual fitness classes offered company\-wide
* Robust PTO offerings including major holidays, vacation, sick, personal, \& volunteer time
* Employee discounts with major providers (i.e. wireless, gym, car rental, etc.)
* Philanthropic support with both local and national organizations
* Fun culture with company\-wide contests and prizes

jobs.title: Senior Global FP&A Specialist - OPEX COS
jobs.description:
**Make an impact at NTT Global Data Centers**

Join NTT Global Data Centers and be part of a team that drives innovation and sustainability in the digital world. With over 150 data centers across more than 20 countries globally, we offer unparalleled opportunities to work on cutting\-edge technology and transformative projects. Experience a collaborative, innovative, and inclusive workplace where your ideas are valued, and your growth is supported.


**Your role at a glance**

The Senior Global FP\&A Specialist – OPEX COS is responsible for analyzing, consolidating, and reporting operational expenditures across the organization’s global data center operations. The role partners with Finance, Data Center Operations, and regional teams to provide accurate, timely, and actionable insights into OPEX performance.
  

  

The Senior Specialist performs end\-to\-end OPEX analysis and reporting, identifying trends, monitoring budget performance for a limited set of specific, high attention assets, and preparing reports for management and executives.
  

  

The role requires a highly experienced FP\&A professional capable of delivering insights and analysis with minimal supervision.
**What we are looking for**

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES  



  

***Communication***

* Act as a senior financial business partner by proactively generating insights, leading strategic analyses, and representing the CoS team at senior management level while shaping key operational decisions.
* Proactively monitor, interpret, and communicate key financial and operational KPIs to influence decisions and strengthen performance management.
* Actively collaborate with business stakeholders and finance partners by initiating the collection of budgeting inputs, contract details, and cost drivers, ensuring complete and accurate financial planning.
* Support the business and other stakeholders in understanding, forecasting and budgeting operational expense for a datacenter.
* Actively collaborate within the global FP\&A community by initiating knowledge sharing and contributing to the development of cross\-functional best practices.

Performs any other relevant task as assigned by the management team.  

* 

***Analysis***

* Deeply understand OPEX data from multiple data centers on a very granular level (supplier contracts, maintenance plans, etc.).
* Actively design and deliver monthly actual\-vs\-budget and forecast reporting, generating clear variance insights at a very detailed level and driving action\-oriented follow\-ups with stakeholders.
* Proactively identify, quantify, and track risks, opportunities, and performance levers to support operational business improvement.
* Proactively assess and challenge business initiatives to ensure alignment with required profitability expectations and long\-term value creation.
* Actively identify and shape cost\-management opportunities to drive sustainable operational and financial performance.
* Actively lead budget and expense reviews on a very detailed level for a few, special attention datacenters, highlight variances early, and initiate cost\-optimization opportunities.
Performs other duties and adhoc analytics as assigned.  
* 

***Process \& Tool improvements***

* Actively drive the design and continuous innovation of reporting tools and templates to ensure operational impacts and financial implications are captured transparently and effectively.
* Actively maintain, enhance, and further innovate tools and templates supporting cost analysis, forecasting, and operational decision\-making.
* Actively drive system improvements by testing, validating, and shaping enhancements across planning platforms such as SAC, SAP, and Power BI.
Proactively contribute to system releases by initiating and executing user testing, ensuring functional and high\-quality platform improvements.  
* 

KNOWLEDGE \& ATTRIBUTES


* Strong expertise in FP\&A processes related to OPEX budgeting, forecasting, consolidation, and reporting.
* Familiarity with data center operational costs, including energy, maintenance, and service delivery costs.
* Proficiency with FP\&A and reporting tools (e.g., Excel, Power BI, SAP, SAC).
* Excellent analytical, problem\-solving, and critical\-thinking skills.
* Able to manage complex, multi\-region OPEX data and reporting deadlines independently.
* Strong business acumen and ability to communicate financial insights effectively to stakeholders.

Detail\-oriented, organized, and capable of producing accurate and timely reports.  

* 

  

ACADEMIC QUALIFICATIONS \& CERTIFICATIONS  



  

* Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related field.
Professional certification preferred (e.g., CPA, CMA, CFA, or equivalent).  
* 

  

REQUIRED EXPERIENCE  



  

* 6–10 years of experience in FP\&A, OPEX analysis, or financial reporting within a global, multi\-entity organization.
* Experience in OPEX forecasting, budgeting, and reporting.
* Experience with FP\&A and reporting systems (e.g., Excel, Power BI, SAP, SAC).
Demonstrated ability to perform complex financial analysis and deliver actionable insights with minimal supervision.  
* 

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS  



* Remain stationary for long periods of time.
* Operate computer, peripherals, and other office equipment.
Perform work during US business hours and time zones.  
* 

WORK CONDITIONS AND OTHER REQUIREMENTS  



  

* Very limited one\-off travel (once or twice annually).
* Perform work from a remote location with stable internet connection.

**Compensation Pay Range**

For roles residing in the US, we share pay and benefit levels to support pay transparency requirements. For other countries, we are more than happy to share our competitive pay and benefit levels during the interview process.  



  

This is a remote position that requires reliable internet connection and electricity. A monthly stipend is provided to cover expenses associated with working remotely and use of a personal mobile device

jobs.title: Human Resources Compliance Analyst (Hybrid/Remote)
jobs.description:
For more than 170 years, The Hanover has been committed to delivering on our promises and being there when it matters the most. We live our values every day, demonstrating we CARE through our values, Sustainability initiatives and inclusive corporate culture.
  
  

The Hanover Insurance Group is seeking a dynamic, proactive, and experienced HR Compliance Analyst to help advance our HR compliance governance program and foster a compliant, people\-first workplace. This highly visible role offers the opportunity to partner across Employee Relations, Legal, Payroll, Compensation, Talent Acquisition, HR Technology, HR Support Services, and other key stakeholders to help ensure regulatory requirements are effectively assessed, implemented, monitored, and sustained across the HR function.
  
  

As a trusted partner and advisor, you'll leverage your experience in HR compliance, governance, audit, risk management, or related disciplines to navigate complex regulatory requirements, support enterprise\-wide compliance initiatives, and drive continuous improvement. You'll play a critical role in strengthening accountability, enhancing operational effectiveness, and helping the organization proactively identify and address compliance risks in an evolving regulatory environment.
  
  

This position offers the flexibility to work remotely or in a hybrid capacity. To support collaboration and connection with the team, we are looking for candidates who reside within the New England region and can travel to the Worcester office as needed for business meetings, team events, and other in\-person activities. Supported by Hanover's flexible work arrangements and guided by our CARE values, you'll join a collaborative team where you can expand your expertise, build strong cross\-functional relationships, and make a meaningful impact across the organization. This is an exceptional opportunity to gain exposure to multiple HR disciplines, partner with leaders across the business, and contribute to initiatives that support both our employees and our continued success.
  
  

THIS IS A FULL\-TIME, EXEMPT ROLE.
  
  

**Position Overview:**  

The HR Compliance Analyst plays a key role in advancing Hanover's HR compliance governance program. This position partners across Human Resources to help identify, monitor, assess, and track compliance obligations while supporting effective governance, risk management, and accountability practices.
  
The HR Compliance Analyst serves as a key partner across Legal and HR functions including Employee Relations, Payroll, Compensation, Talent Acquisition, HR Support Services, and external compliance resources. To promote a proactive and sustainable approach to compliance. Through cross\-functional collaboration, analysis, reporting, process improvement, the successful candidate will ensure compliance requirements are vetted, owned, monitored, and executed consistently across HR.
  
  

**IN THIS ROLE YOU WILL:**  

Compliance Coordination \& Implementation Support
  
* Coordinate review of regulatory changes with impacted HR functions and Legal, as needed.
* Facilitate stakeholder discussions to clarify ownership, responsibilities, implementation plans.
* Support the development and distribution of compliance guidance, communications, and resources.
* Monitor compliance\-related training requirements, ownership, and completion to support compliance readiness.
* Track implementation activities, key milestones, and outstanding actions to ensure timely completion of compliance\-related obligations.


Regulatory Monitoring \& Compliance Intelligence
  
* Manage HR compliance vendor relationships and external resources to support regulatory monitoring, compliance intelligence, and readiness.
* Monitor regulatory developments and identify potential impacts across HR functions.
* Administer Employee Relations\-owned compliance programs and reporting requirements.
* Review, update, and maintain HR policies, standards, and related documentation in response to regulatory changes, business needs, and external developments.


Compliance Governance \& Reporting
  
* Maintain the HR compliance inventory, including regulatory requirements, ownership, key controls, and governance documentation.
* Monitor compliance obligations, implementation status, and emerging risks. Identify and elevate potential gaps or concerns.
* Facilitate compliance reviews and support tracking of key priorities and action items.
* Prepare dashboards, scorecards, and compliance reporting for HR leadership.
* Support regulatory examinations, internal audits, enterprise risk reviews, and compliance assessments by coordinating documentation, evidence collection, and stakeholder preparation.


Process Improvement \& Operational Effectiveness
  
* Identify opportunities to enhance compliance tracking, reporting, and operational effectiveness.
* Support HR teams in simplifying or automating compliance\-related activities.
* Maintain compliance tools, templates, and supporting resources that support compliance governance and program management.
* Ability to maintain sound judgement and attention to detail while managing multiple priorities under pressure in a fast\-paced environment.


**WHAT YOU NEED TO APPLY:**  

* Bachelor's degree preferred.
* Minimum of 3\-5 years of diverse Human Resources, Compliance, HR Operations, Employee Relations, Payroll, Benefits, HR Technology, or related experience.
* Under minimal supervision, supports HR compliance governance activities and helps HR partners comply with and administer policies, programs, and regulatory requirements.
* Experience coordinating projects, programs, or compliance\-related activities involving multiple stakeholders.
* Demonstrates strong organizational, analytical, and problem\-solving skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines.
* Exercises independent judgment within established guidelines to resolve routine and moderately complex issues

jobs.title: Billing Analyst
jobs.description:
**About Us:** Prometric is a leading provider of technology\-enabled testing and assessment solutions to many of the world’s most recognized licensing and certification organizations, academic institutions, and government agencies. We support more than 7 million test takers annually at our testing locations in 180 countries around the world. With over three decades of experience working with clients of all sizes across a multitude of industry sectors, our mission is to design and deliver the highest quality and most innovative testing solutions anytime, anywhere.
  
  

**JOB TITLE:** Billing Analyst
  
**REPORTS TO:** Accounting, Manager
  
**DEPARTMEN:** Finance \& Accounting
  
**LOCATION:** Remote in U.S
  
  

JOB OVERVIEW
  
Prometric is looking for an energetic and self\-motivated individual to join our Accounting team. We are a goal\-oriented team that works hard and enjoys being committed to the financial performance of Prometric. The candidate will be responsible for accurate client billing, executing the timely issuance of invoices in accordance with contractual requirements. The ability to understand the revenue recognition policy, analyzing revenue activities, and subport the account team. If you enjoy working in a fast\-paced environment, this job may be a good fit for you.
  
COMPANY BACKGROUND
  
Prometric (www.prometric.com) is a trusted test development and delivery provider to more than 300 organizations worldwide. Prometric serves as an industry gatekeeper, ensuring that people legitimately earn the credentials they seek to achieve, and thereby guaranteeing a fair testing experience for all who come through our doors.
  
RESPONSIBILITIES
  
* Analyze billing details and issue accurate client invoices.
* Ability to comprehend complex contracts, supporting agreements, identify pertinent terms and implement.
* Review invoices to ensure billing accuracy.
* Communicate with clients, Client Success Manager, and other departments, resolving issues, and providing clarifications.
* Verify with other departments that services have been delivered and contract terms met.
* Analyze billing procedures and identify opportunities for improvement.
* Prepare reports and meeting billing deadlines.
* Maintain updated records of accounts receivable.

StackCommerce is the leading content\-driven commerce platform, seamlessly connecting brands with engaged audiences across the full customer journey. Our unmatched network comprises over 2,500 brands, 8,000 creators, and thousands of world\-renowned media outlets — including Hearst, Gannett, Ziff Davis, G/O Media, News Corp, Dotdash Meredith, Foundry, and more — as well as our owned\-and\-operated marketplace, StackSocial, which brings exclusive deals directly to millions of consumers. A TPG portfolio company, StackCommerce has expanded its ecosystem through the acquisitions of BrandCycle, The Fascination, and Reviewed. Learn more at StackCommerce.com.


**The Role:**



The Performance Media Buyer is a key member of the StackMedia team and is responsible for delivering smart, innovative, and performance\-driven digital campaigns for its clients. At StackCommerce, we're building something different: content funnels that pair our clients with respected publisher brands, turning that trusted editorial voice into real third\-party credibility for the brands we work with.



The Performance Media Buyer will be responsible for planning and executing digital ad campaigns across a variety of mediums that include but are not limited to social, native, programmatic, email, newsletter, sponsored content, influencer partnerships, and more with the goal of achieving clients specific goals. The ideal candidate for this position is proactive, organized, accurate, and able to problem\-solve. They take the lead in identifying and adopting successful strategies, platforms, or experiments in order to drive performance. They are adaptable and easily adopt new strategies and have a passion for testing and experimentation.


**What You'll Do:**


* Set up and launch digital campaigns on ad networks

* Identify new ad networks for testing

Because of injury or illness, many people struggle to perform everyday tasks, an experience that can be frustrating and even painful. Physical medicine is the art of helping you relearn how to use your body, while improving your flexibility, strength and coordination.
  

  

Physical Medicine \& Rehabilitation (PM\&R) — also known as physiatry — benefits many patients, including sufferers of multiple sclerosis, spinal cord injury, back pain, ligament problems, arthritis and Parkinson's disease.
  

  

Our team includes psychologists, physical therapists, occupational therapists and exercise therapists who collaborate with you to restore your quality of life and have you living independently again.  


Responsibilities:

Under the general direction of the Chief Administrative Officer and department finance team, the individual is responsible for the Department of Physical Medicine and Rehabilitation’s fiscal related matters including budgeting, financial analysis, contracts and grants, and post award management. Funding sources include general funds, federal/state contracts and grants, private gifts and grants, clinical trials, start\-up funds, clinical revenue model funds, professional fees, and sales service income. The individual provides high level policy analysis and interpretation and performs independent problem solving that requires interaction with physicians, Principal Investigators, laboratory staff and various levels of accounting and sponsored projects personnel. The individual applies financial concepts to process, review, and approve financial transactions. Strategizes and recommends innovative fiscal solutions to the CAO and department finance team. Under general direction of department CAO, the individual is responsible for providing financial analysis and reporting on all account funds, budgeting, projections and fiscal close functions. Establishes and maintains complex financial control and reporting systems. Administers department payroll certifications.

jobs.title: Senior Fiscal Analyst
jobs.description:
The Judicial Council of California is accepting applications for the position of Senior Fiscal Analyst with the State Budget unit of the Budget Services office.

  

  

The Senior Fiscal Analyst provides advanced, complex, and specialized analytical and technical budget support to the Judicial Council Facilities Services Capital Outlay program. This position provides fiscal oversight for capital outlay projects and manages the ongoing project close\-out activities.  



  

Responsibilities include analyzing and preparing statewide budget reports for management, monitoring and controlling capital outlay appropriations, reviewing and coding requisitions, preparing and reviewing Capital Outlay budget change proposals (COBCPs), reviewing the updated five\-year capital outlay plan, and managing the bond sale process. The position conducts monthly fiscal forecasting for each project by appropriation, line item, and category of expense, that are completed three times a year for every project. The position is also responsible for ensuring project compliance with appropriation availability periods, recommends reappropriations when needed, forecasts cash flow to ensure cash flow loans remain sufficient and advises Facilities Services staff on project scope, cost, and budget changes during the bi\-monthly budget meetings with Facilities Services management.  



  

This position prepares and review materials required by the State Public Works Board and the Department of Finance for the ongoing phases of Capital Outlay projects, including memos, fiscal displays, and agenda items. These package submissions are done approximately eight times annually. The role also updates and escalates project costs for Executive staff to support accurate advocacy for project funding. In addition, the position manages the twice\-yearly bond sales process, a 3\.5 month cycle involving extensive preparation, detailed bond document review, meeting participation, and coordination with the Judicial Council Facilities Program, Department of Finance, the State Treasurer’s Office, Judicial Council Legal services, and the tenant courts. The position also prepares and reviews budget documents and fiscal displays containing Capital Outlay budget data for inclusion in the budget galley, published three times per year, and provides backup support to other areas within the State Budget Unit.


**The Judicial Council**
  

The Judicial Council of California is the policy setting body for the state court system and has constitutionally conferred statewide rule\-making authority. This authority includes developing, advocating for, and allocating the judicial branch budget. A majority of Council members are California state justices and judges; however, the Council also includes lawyers, legislators, and court administrators.


By enhancing its role as a leadership, knowledge, and service resource for the judicial branch, the Judicial Council’s staff organization seeks to continue to evolve as one of California’s most dynamic public service entities, focused on improving access to justice for all Californians by innovating and responding to the changing needs of the courts and the public. As a government body charged with improving the statewide administration of justice, the Judicial Council has multiple offices with diverse responsibilities relating to court policy and operations. As employees of the council, every member of staff should view and approach their work as one Judicial Council with a public service mission that is greater than the sum of its parts.


The Judicial Council strives for work\-life balance, including substantial vacation and holiday time. In addition, we offer an excellent benefits package, including pension, medical, dental, and vision coverage, flexible spending, up to $130 per month reimbursement for qualifying commuting costs, student loan forgiveness as part of Public Service Loan Forgiveness (PSLF), and retirement savings plans. The San Francisco office is only a 7\-minute walk from the downtown Civic Center BART station. In Sacramento, the office is located minutes from downtown, just north of Discovery Park.


The Judicial Council offers hybrid work arrangements for many positions. The successful candidate will be expected to work in person at the Judicial Council’s San Francisco or Sacramento office at least two days per week, based on their office leader’s direction, and reside in the areas surrounding these locations. To be eligible for Judicial Council employment and participation in the Judicial Council’s Hybrid Work Program, a prospective or current employee’s primary residence/remote work location must be in the State of California and within a 150\-mile driving radius of their assigned reporting location.

  

**Responsibilities**
--------------------


* Prepare complex technical budget documents associated with the development of Judicial Branch’s annual budget in accordance with Department of Finance Budget Letters and other guidelines.
* Develop and maintain budget reports and memos, tables, and trackers.
* Review and prepare SPWB project action packages and coordinate with DOF staff.
* Prepare and review COBCPs and other fiscal documentation to develop the budget galley.
* Provide advanced, specialized level of analysis and support regarding budgetary, technical, and analytical support in the areas of budget development, management, expenditure forecasting, position and appropriation control (i.e. spending and reimbursement authority) for the most complex Judicial Council offices.
* Project manage interim cash flow loans and bond sale process to include judicial branch projects in statewide bond sales for new money and refinancing of current debt.
* Prepare documentation and consult with the Facilities Program to assess cash flow needs of each capital outlay project to ensure successful completion of capital outlay projects. Support additional Facilities related activities.

jobs.title: Senior Associate, FP&A
jobs.description:
We're hiring a Senior Associate, FP\&A to be the analyst behind our marketplace levers — recruiter incentives and retainers, pricing and take rate, unit economics, and vertical P\&Ls. You'll run the monthly budget vs. actuals review, maintain the operating model with our VP Finance, and be the analytical partner leadership leans on for pricing and incentive decisions. You'll report to our VP Finance and work closely with our accounting team.


This is a builder role. Marketplace economics are more interesting than a standard SaaS P\&L — take rates, recruiter supply, roles posted, time\-to\-hire, and placement timing all drive revenue — and you'll build the analysis the company runs on.

**What you'll do**
------------------

* **Maintain the operating model with the VP Finance.** Keep the drivers current — revenue, GMV, headcount, OpEx — and support the annual plan and quarterly reforecasts.
* **Model marketplace levers.** Recruiter incentives and retainers, pricing and take rate, and fee structures — build the analysis behind each decision and track what happens after it ships.
* **Own unit economics.** GMV, net revenue, take rate, recruiter payouts, cohort behavior, LTV:CAC, and payback — the numbers leadership makes pricing and incentive calls on**.**
* **Run budget vs. actuals.** Monthly BvA and department\-level flux review with our accounting team, with clear variance explanations for leadership.
* **Build the metrics layer.** Partner with RevOps and BizOps to define metrics and build the dashboards leadership uses every week.
* **Automate with AI.** We use AI heavily across the company and expect finance to as well — recurring reporting shouldn't be manual.

**What we're looking for**
--------------------------

* 3–5 years in FP\&A, strategic finance, investment banking, PE, or top\-tier consulting, with at least 1–2 years building models an operating team actually used.
* Expert spreadsheet modeling — three\-statement, driver\-based forecasts, and scenario analysis.
* Comfortable presenting numbers to executives and turning an ambiguous question into a clear answer.
* High ownership, low ego, and fast. Your work goes straight to the exec team and board.
* Bonus: experience at a marketplace, fintech, or usage\-based business; a Series B–C fundraise; hands\-on with a planning tool (Pigment, Anaplan) or SQL/BI (Metabase, Looker).

**The ideal candidate brings**
------------------------------

* Experience in multi\-sided / marketplace businesses
* Has owned analysis of a marketing subsidy or incentive program
* Has built the take\-rate or pricing model at a marketplace and defended it to leadership
* Has run a monthly BvA where department leads had to explain their variances to them
* Has worked from raw transaction data (SQL or exports), not just a finance system's outputs
* Has gone through a raise on the company side: model, data room, diligence questions

**About Paraform:**

Paraform is a marketplace modernizing one of the largest and most fragmented markets in the world: hiring. **We partner with industry leaders like Decagon, Palantir, Rippling, Abridge, and Hightouch** to hire world\-class talent, and are growing quickly \- **8×\-ing revenue last year.**


Paraform is the first end\-to\-end AI recruiting marketplace that connects companies with thousands of specialized recruiters and AI agents that work together to fill roles faster and more accurately.


Our mission is to make hiring fast, reliable, and scalable for every company in the world. For more on where we're headed, read our company vision.


At Paraform, we believe recruiting works best when the right people are working on the right problems, combining human judgment with AI that truly understands hiring. That’s why we’re building a new foundation for how companies hire, bringing together specialized recruiters and modern AI tools.


We treat recruiters like entrepreneurs, not vendors – and we’re building the financial, operational, and technical infrastructure that powers their success.


We are backed by the best investors and technology leaders: Scale, Felicis, A\*, BOND, Liquid 2, DST Global, the founders of YouTube, Instacart, Canva, and more.

jobs.description:
**Position Summary**

Under direct supervision, the Supply Chain Buyer supports purchasing, material planning, and logistics activities to ensure uninterrupted production. The role is primarily responsible for purchase order execution, supplier management, material availability, and ERP accuracy, while also coordinating logistics for purchased materials.


The position works closely with Planning, Manufacturing, Finance, Warehouse, suppliers, freight forwarders, and global supply chain teams. The successful candidate must demonstrate strong ownership, follow\-through, and the ability to proactively identify and resolve supply and logistics issues.


**Key Responsibilities**

**Purchasing \& Material Management**

* Execute and manage purchase orders with domestic and international suppliers based on demand, MRP requirements, and production schedules.
* Monitor supplier commitments, delivery dates, open orders, and on\-time delivery performance in the ERP system.
* Maintain accurate purchasing master data, including supplier information, lead times, and pricing.
* Communicate with suppliers on delivery commitments, shortages, expedites, and supply issues.
* Track PPV, validate pricing against approved quotes/contracts, and support cost\-control initiatives.
* Partner with Planning, Manufacturing, Finance, and Accounts Payable to resolve material, pricing, invoice, and receiving issues.

**Logistics Coordination**

* Coordinate transportation of purchased materials with freight forwarders and logistics providers.
* Track inbound and outbound shipments and proactively address delays, delivery risks, and transportation issues.
* Obtain and review freight quotations, coordinate shipment routing/allocation, and verify freight invoices against agreed rates.
* Coordinate quarter\-end shipments and expedite critical or time\-sensitive deliveries.
* Maintain visibility of in\-transit inventory and provide timely status updates to internal stakeholders.
* Coordinate with suppliers, freight forwarders, customs brokers, and internal teams to resolve customs, receiving, and delivery issues.

**Cross\-Functional \& Global Collaboration**

* Flexibility to support global supply chain operations outside of standard business hours is an important requirement of this position.
* Participate in supply chain meetings and provide updates on purchase orders, material availability, supplier commitments, and logistics.
* Work with global supply chain teams and suppliers across multiple time zones to support material availability and shipment execution.
* Escalate critical supply, supplier, or logistics risks in a timely manner.
* Support process improvements related to purchasing efficiency, supplier performance, logistics execution, and lead\-time reduction.
* Ensure procurement and logistics activities comply with company policies and documentation requirements.

**Qualifications**

* 2\+ years of experience in purchasing, procurement, materials, or supply chain operations, preferably in technology, electronics, or manufacturing.
* Experience managing purchase orders, suppliers, material availability, and delivery commitments.
* Experience working with freight forwarders, carriers, or logistics providers strongly preferred.
* Working knowledge of MRP, waterfall analysis, and RYG reporting in an EMS/electronics manufacturing environment.
* Familiarity with electronic components and BOMs preferred.
* Experience with international suppliers and shipments is a plus.
* Strong analytical, organizational, communication, and follow\-through skills.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast\-paced environment and proactively resolve issues.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office, particularly Excel.
* ERP experience required; Oracle experience preferred.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills in English; Mandarin\-speaking ability is a plus.

**Education \& Experience**

* Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain Management, Logistics, Business, or a related field preferred.
* Associate degree with relevant purchasing/logistics experience may also be considered.
2\+ years of relevant experience in purchasing, materials, logistics, transportation, or supply chain operations, preferably in a manufacturing environment.

jobs.title: Senior Buyer
jobs.description:
**Job Summary**

The Senior Buyer plays a critical role in ensuring the reliable, cost‑effective, and compliant procurement of materials, components, and services required for aerospace manufacturing and operations. This position is responsible for managing strategic suppliers, negotiating high‑value contracts, mitigating supply chain risks, and ensuring adherence to industry standards such as AS9100, ITAR, and FAR/DFARS requirements. The Senior Buyer partners closely with engineering, quality, production, and program management to support on time delivery and long‑term business objectives.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Strategic Sourcing \& Procurement**

* Develop and execute sourcing strategies for complex aerospace components, raw materials, and specialized services.
* Manage end\-to\-end procurement for complex aerospace categories (e.g., Outsource machined parts, electronics, composites, castings, or specialized hardware).
* Identify, evaluate, and qualify suppliers in accordance with aerospace regulatory and quality standards. Ensure all purchasing activities comply with **AS9100**, **NADCAP**, **ITAR**, **EAR**, and FAR/DFARS regulations where applicable.
* Identify and implement cost\-saving and cost\-avoidance initiatives without compromising quality or delivery timelines.
* Lead competitive bid processes, cost analyses, and purchase justifications to streamline supplier selection and evaluation.

**Supplier Management**

* Monitor and manage critical aerospace suppliers. Track key metrics such as On\-Time Delivery (OTD) and First Pass Yield (FPY). Partner with Quality Assurance to address supplier Corrective Action Requests (SCARs) \& Drive supplier corrective actions and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with domestic and international suppliers.

**Contracting \& Negotiation**

* Negotiate pricing, terms, long‑term agreements, and risk‑sharing arrangements.
* Ensure compliance with ITAR, EAR, FAR/DFARS, and customer‑specific flow‑down requirements.
* Manage contract lifecycle activities including renewals, amendments, and performance reviews.

**Cross‑Functional Collaboration**

* Work closely with engineering to interpret technical drawings, specifications, and BOM requirements.
* Partner with production planning to ensure material availability and resolve supply constraints.
* Collaborate with quality teams on supplier audits, FAI requirements, and non‑conformance resolution.

**Data, Reporting \& Risk Management**

* Analyze market trends, cost drivers, and supply chain risks to support decision‑making.
* Maintain accurate procurement data in ERP/MRP systems (e.g., SAP, Oracle, Epicor).
* Develop mitigation plans for long‑lead items, sole‑source suppliers, and critical components.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in supply chain, Business, Engineering, or related field (master’s is a plus).
* 5–10\+ years of procurement experience, with at least 3 years in the **aerospace or defense industry**.
* Strong understanding of **AS9100**, **ITAR/EAR**, and **FAR/DFARS** compliance.
* Proven track record of negotiating complex, high‑value contracts.
* Experience with ERP/MRP systems and advanced Excel or analytics tools.
* Ability to read and interpret engineering drawings and technical specifications.
* Excellent communication, problem‑solving, and supplier‑relationship skills.
* Professional certifications (e.g., **CPM, CPSM, CSCP, CPIM**) are a plus.

**\#\# Core Competencies**

* Strategic thinking and long\-term planning
* Strong analytical and financial acumen
* Supplier development and performance management
* Cross\-functional leadership
* Risk assessment and mitigation
* High attention to detail in a regulated environment

**Why This Role Matters**

Senior Buyers in aerospace aren’t just purchasing parts—they’re safeguarding production schedules, ensuring regulatory compliance, and shaping the resilience of the entire supply chain. This role directly impacts product quality, customer satisfaction, and the company’s competitive position in a demanding industry.

Pay: $85,000\.00 \- $100,000\.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* 401(k) matching
* Dental insurance
* Health insurance
* Life insurance
* Paid time off
* Vision insurance

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Avionics Buyer
jobs.description:
K2 is building the largest and highest\-power satellites ever flown, unlocking performance levels previously out of reach across every orbit. Backed by over $1 billion in total funding from leading investors including Altimeter Capital, ICONIQ, Kleiner Perkins, Lightspeed Venture Partners, Redpoint Ventures, and T. Rowe Price — and with over $1 billion in signed contracts across commercial and US government customers, we're mass\-producing the highest\-power satellite platforms ever built for missions from LEO to deep space.



The rise of heavy\-lift launch vehicles is shifting the industry from an era of mass constraint to one of mass abundance, and we believe this new era demands a fundamentally different class of spacecraft. Engineered to survive the harshest radiation environments and to fully capitalize on today's and tomorrow's massive rockets, K2 satellites deliver unmatched capability at constellation scale and across multiple orbits.



With multiple launches in 2027 and plans to scale to 100 satellites a year, we're Building Bigger — helping develop the solar system and build toward a Kardashev Type II (K2\) civilization. If you are a motivated individual who thrives in a fast\-paced environment and you're excited about contributing to the success of a high\-growth Series D\-funded company, we'd love for you to apply.

**The Role**



You will be responsible for several aspects of the critical supply chain organization. You will be responsible for finding, building, and managing the quality of parts running in our electrical, solar, and GNC supply chains. Key skills will include technical procurement of electrical hardware and Bill of Material (BOM) management for owned assemblies. You will travel to suppliers in order to monitor progress and health while negotiating business contracts and price reductions over time to ensure strategic reductions in costs over time.

Technical Procurement

Material Planning
